card.name: Inside split-up medical word spellings
card.fires_on: A short piece in the middle of a longer word that is split into odd parts, such as the c in hypoglycemia, the z in eszopiclone, or yl in H. pylori. It fires on the part just before the word's ending.

modes.label: Glycemia words
modes.description: The letter c inside words ending in -glycemia, after the ly part.
